announcement.goals.bomber: Plant bombs on players! You cannot buy knife or gun. You can see players carrying your timed bomb through walls.
announcement.goals.breacher: Create indoor break points to pressure the passenger side. If nobody maintains your break point in time, the killer side splits a coin reward.
announcement.goals.phonism: You hear sounds that are not there — and you can make others hear them too. Pick a player and a sound: the hallucination plays from their position and misleads everyone who hears it. Using it on a dead player makes no sound at all.
announcement.goals.assassin: Use your keen eye to expose players' true identities! Right guess—BANG! Wrong guess—also BANG! (Vigilante's too smart to fool)

announcement.goals.reporter: Mark a player to see them through walls!
announcement.goals.serial_killer: You hunt without a target: the shop offers you only knives and tools, and your knife cooldown is halved. Psycho Mode grants devastating power — but every frenzy starts a countdown to your own death.
announcement.goals.attendant: Check your passenger manifest to see who's in each room!
announcement.goals.taotie: Swallow all players or survive 2 minutes during Taotie Moment to win!
game.win.taotie: The endless hunger has finally been satisfied.
announcement.goals.silencer: Shut them up! Silenced targets can't speak, hear others, eat food, drink cocktails, and their SAN drains faster.
announcement.goals.bodyguard: With empty hands, press the ability key to enter a crouching stance: hold your ground and block frontal knife stabs and bat swings. A successful block briefly disarms your attacker, but leaves you recovering for a long time - watch your back!
announcement.goals.poisoner: Use poison needles and gas bombs to poison your enemies! You can also use poison vials and scorpions.
announcement.goals.bandit: Use throwing axes to kill from range! Hold longer for further throws, penetrates through players!
announcement.goals.baosang: When someone dies, the death knell tolls within you. Wait a moment, and the news will reveal itself.
announcement.goals.junker: The relics left in these carriages are your only chance — you can see dropped items through walls, and dig out of the dead what they never had time to use.
announcement.goals.white_knight: You are the last keeper of order on this train — but order comes at a price.
announcement.goals.economist: Every coin on this train deserves a ledger entry — you only trust the numbers.
announcement.goals.survival_master: You are invisible to killer instinct! When conditions are met, Survival Moment activates — survive 120 seconds to win!

announcement.goals.riot_patrol: You are on the passenger side. Right-click to raise the riot shield and block melee attacks from the front, but your view locks and you slow down heavily; left-click with it to shove nearby players back. The riot fork roots both you and a target within 3 blocks for 8 seconds.
announcement.goals.hunter: You are on the killer side. Kill all innocents; if no neutral role completes its objective, killers win. Bear traps disable movement input for 3 seconds and apply Fracture. Fracture blocks sprinting and stamina recovery, reduces movement speed by 20% per stack, and each stack heals after 60 seconds. Use a Poison Vial on a placed trap to coat it; when it triggers, the poisoning killer gains 75 coins and the Hunter gains 50 coins. Innocent-side trap vision is limited to Vigilante, Veteran, Riot Patrol, Corrupt Cop, and Engineer. Only Veteran, Riot Patrol, Corrupt Cop, and Engineer can dismantle traps.

item.noellesroles.hunter_trap.tooltip.li: - Place a bear trap at your feet.
- Victims lose movement input for 3 seconds.
- Applies 1 Fracture stack: no sprint, no stamina recovery, 20% movement slow per stack, 60s heal time per stack. Bone Setting is consumed first to negate 1 stack.
- Use a Poison Vial on a placed trap to coat it.

- Poisoned triggers give 75 coins to the poisoner and 50 to the Hunter. Visible to killers, Vigilante, Veteran, Riot Patrol, Corrupt Cop, and Engineer; only Veteran, Riot Patrol, Corrupt Cop, and Engineer can dismantle it.
- To reload, open your inventory, hold a shell, and right-click the shotgun.
- Straight shot with an effective range of 8 blocks.
- After the first shell is loaded, you have 10 seconds to load the second shell. If the window expires, you must fire before reloading again.
- Firing has a 1 second cooldown; if the chamber becomes empty, the cooldown becomes 30 seconds. Does not drop on death or after killing an innocent.
- Buying the shotgun comes with one free shell.

roleinfo.screen.title: Gameplay Info
roleinfo.summary.killer: You can use killer instinct to see nearby players and buy weapons and tools from the killer shop.
roleinfo.summary.civilian: You have no special abilities; survive and finish your tasks.
roleinfo.summary.vigilante: You start with a revolver and can spot hunter bear traps.
roleinfo.summary.loose_end: You carry a derringer and a knife; clear every threat and be the last one standing.
roleinfo.summary.veteran: You are immune to blackouts, carry a reusable knife, and can spot and disarm hunter traps.
roleinfo.summary.morphling: You can take on other players' appearances, or disguise yourself as a corpse.
roleinfo.summary.phantom: You can turn invisible, though fellow killers can still see you with instinct.
roleinfo.summary.swapper: You can swap the positions of two players, including yourself.
roleinfo.summary.the_insane_damned_paran: You can hear the voices of nearby dead players and catch the clues they leave behind.
roleinfo.summary.bomber: You can plant timed bombs on players and see who is carrying one.
roleinfo.summary.assassin: You can guess a target's identity: guess right and they die, guess wrong and you do.
roleinfo.summary.scavenger: Your knife strikes need no charge, and your victims' bodies vanish from passengers' eyes.
roleinfo.summary.serial_killer: You can enter a psycho rage at will, and your knife cooldown is shorter.
roleinfo.summary.silencer: You can silence a target, cutting off their voice, food and sanity.
roleinfo.summary.poisoner: You have poison needles, gas bombs and other tools, and you are immune to gas.
roleinfo.summary.bandit: You can hurl a charged throwing axe that pierces through several players. You can also throw every axe at once, and pay coins to recover the axes you have thrown.
roleinfo.summary.commander: You can mark threatened targets; other killers know you, but you shoot yourself if they all die.
roleinfo.summary.breacher: You can set a breach point indoors; leave it unrepaired and the killers earn a bounty.
roleinfo.summary.phonism: You can play fake sounds around a chosen player to mislead everyone.
roleinfo.summary.hunter: You can place bear traps and buy a double-barrel shotgun to finish off trapped prey.
roleinfo.summary.conductor: You carry a master key that opens every door on the train.
roleinfo.summary.awesome_binglus: You start with a big stack of notes; write whatever you like.
roleinfo.summary.bartender: You can buy drinks, and you can see who has just had one.
roleinfo.summary.noisemaker: You can broadcast your voice to everyone, and your death will alert them too.
roleinfo.summary.voodoo: You can buy voodoo dolls to bind a curse: when someone causes your death, they go down with you.
roleinfo.summary.coroner: With enough sanity, examining a body reveals its name, role, cause of death and time of death.
roleinfo.summary.recaller: You can record a spot and pay to teleport back to it.
roleinfo.summary.time_keeper: You can spend coins to shorten the round's remaining time.
roleinfo.summary.undercover: You carry a walkie-talkie, and killer instinct shows you as an ally.
roleinfo.summary.toxicologist: You can spot poison and poisoned players, cure them with antidotes, or shield others against poison.
roleinfo.summary.professor: You can use Iron Man vials to shield others from one lethal hit or swallow.
roleinfo.summary.attendant: You carry the attendant's register and can look up and record every passenger's room, meeting status, survival and role.
roleinfo.summary.reporter: You can buy notes. Anyone marked by your ability stays visible to you.
roleinfo.summary.bodyguard: With empty hands you can guard, blocking knife and bat attacks from the front.
roleinfo.summary.survival_master: Killer instinct cannot see you; trigger Survival Moment and outlast the clock to win for the passengers.
roleinfo.summary.engineer: You sense picked or blocked doors and can repair, lock or unlock them, and disarm hunter traps.
roleinfo.summary.riot_patrol: You carry a riot shield and fork: block attacks from the front, or pin a target in place.
roleinfo.summary.orthopedist: You can grant others Bone Setting, and your own stride is lighter.
roleinfo.summary.saint: Passengers cannot kill you; ignite Hellfire to set a trap and brand your killer with sin.
roleinfo.summary.baosang: Whenever someone dies, their name appears to you moments later.
roleinfo.summary.junker: You can see dropped items through walls and loot corpses for items.
roleinfo.summary.economist: You can buy the economic report to watch the richest player's coin count.
roleinfo.summary.white_knight: You carry a revolver and can see psycho players through walls, piercing their shields.
roleinfo.summary.jester: Shot by a passenger, you revive elsewhere and enter psycho mode.
roleinfo.summary.vulture: You can devour corpses for buffs; eat half the players and you win alone.
roleinfo.summary.corrupt_cop: You stop any faction from winning normally; when few remain, you enter Corrupt Cop Moment.
roleinfo.summary.gangster_star: You carry a revolver and master key, and can buy bullets or a short psycho mode triggered on death.
roleinfo.summary.pathogen: You can infect other players and spread the plague across the round.
roleinfo.summary.taotie: You can devour players to stave off hunger; survive until the Taotie Moment ends to win.
roleinfo.summary.criminal_reasoner: You can solve murders by naming killers; you carry a neutral master key, and successes grant invisibility charges.
roleinfo.summary.ferryman: You can ferry corpses into bones, and with a blessing you can negate a lethal blow.
roleinfo.category.classic.name: Classic Murder Mode
roleinfo.category.classic.subtitle: Classic Murder Mode
roleinfo.category.classic.description: Classic Murder is the core gameplay framework of Parox Express. Each match revolves around conflict between passenger, killer, and neutral roles; choose a faction category on the left, then expand it to inspect the full role descriptions.
roleinfo.category.murder_mayhem.name: Murder Mayhem
roleinfo.category.murder_mayhem.subtitle: Murder Mayhem
roleinfo.category.murder_mayhem.descript: Murder Mayhem is an event-driven variant of Classic Murder. It reuses the same maps, roles, round length, and win rules, but each round starts with a random event that can reshape the match.
roleinfo.category.loose_ends.name: Loose Ends
roleinfo.category.loose_ends.subtitle: Loose Ends Mode
roleinfo.category.loose_ends.description: In Loose Ends mode, every player is a Loose End. Everyone carries a derringer and a knife, and your goal is to eliminate every threat before they eliminate you, becoming the final survivor.
roleinfo.category.passenger.name: Passenger Faction
roleinfo.category.passenger.description: The passenger faction usually wins by surviving to the end and identifying the killers through teamwork, tasks, information, and tools. Most passenger roles have sanity and rely more on coordination and on-the-spot judgment.
roleinfo.category.killer.name: Killer Faction
roleinfo.category.killer.description: The killer faction clears the match through infiltration, misdirection, and kills. Different killer roles lean into assassination, control, tracking, or economy, but they all share the same win goal.
roleinfo.category.neutral.name: Neutral Faction
roleinfo.category.neutral.description: Neutral roles each have their own independent win conditions and do not need to fully side with passengers or killers. Use your role's strengths to hide your identity, control the pace, and complete your personal objective in the chaos.
shared.effect.killer_instinct: You can see other players through walls, see the remaining round time, have no sanity, can sprint infinitely, and cannot pick up a revolver.
shared.effect.killer_shop: You can buy killer-only items here. Killing a player grants you 100 coins.
shared.effect.neutral_master_key: You carry a neutral master key that can open train doors and small wooden doors locked by room keys.
shared.effect.passenger: You are on the passenger side, have sanity and sanity tasks, have limited sprint stamina, and can pick up a revolver.
shared.effect.trap_control: You can see traps placed by the Hunter and dismantle them.
roleinfo.skill.shared.block_victory.name: Victory Lockdown
roleinfo.skill.shared.block_victory.effe: As long as you are alive, neither killers nor passengers can fulfill their win conditions.
screen.spectator_assist_panel.title: Spectator Assist Panel
screen.spectator_assist_panel.subtitle: Click avatar to teleport
screen.spectator_assist_panel.replay_sum: No replay records related to this player
roleinfo.skill.attendant.manifest.effect: Right-click to open the register panel showing every passenger's avatar and ID; hover an avatar to see their ID, meeting status, survival, role and room. Right-click a living player within 3 blocks to mark them as met, or a body within 3 blocks to mark them as dead. Skeletonized bodies cannot be identified and are only highlighted. Click an avatar to edit the records (ID and room are read-only).
roleinfo.skill.attendant.manifest.name: Attendant's Register
roleinfo.skill.bartender.wine_tasting.ef: Every two "have a drink" tasks completed grants one random cocktail material (excluding ice cubes and base spirits).
roleinfo.skill.bodyguard.defensive_stanc: With an empty main hand, press the ability key to enter a crouching guard stance: you are forced to sneak, cannot rotate your view or switch items, and block frontal (shield-like) knife stabs and bat swings. A successful block puts the attacker's knife on a 2-second cooldown or bat on a 6-second cooldown, and your own ability on a 90-second cooldown. Press the ability key again to end the stance early (3-second cooldown).
roleinfo.skill.criminal_reasoner.invisib: Each new successful reasoning grants one invisibility charge (remaining charges are shown at the bottom right). Press ability key 2 to turn invisible for 20 seconds; you cannot be seen through walls by any highlight, and you cannot activate it again while it lasts.
roleinfo.skill.criminal_reasoner.neutral: You carry a neutral master key, which opens train doors and the small wooden doors locked by room keys.
Press the ability key to open the reasoning menu: pick a victim you have not solved yet, then pair them with the player you suspect. Only dead players can be victims, and you cannot pick yourself as the victim. When a victim was pushed off the train, the killer is whoever pushed them off; only when nobody can be held responsible (falling out of the train on their own, a shot innocent (small brain), a mental breakdown or quitting the game) does the killer count as the victim themselves. A success marks the victim as solved, counts toward your victory progress, grants one invisibility charge, and 5 seconds later all police, neutral, killer and spectator players are notified. Success sets a 5 second cooldown; failure sets 60 seconds.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.bullet.effe: Costs 100 coins. Adds 1 remaining revolver use.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.bullet.name: Revolver Bullet
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.instinct.ef: Hold the instinct key to see other players with the same deep purple outline as your role color. Survival Master's concealment still applies.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.gangster_sp: Costs 200 coins. If you are killed by a gun, enter 20 seconds of psycho mode with no armour, then die normally.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.neutral.eff: You are neutral, lose sanity normally, have default stamina, earn 50 coins from tasks, and do not lose sanity for gun kills.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.neutral_mas: You carry a neutral master key.
roleinfo.skill.gangster_star.revolver.ef: You start with a revolver. It has 1 remaining use at round start.
Buy for 150 coins in the shop: for 15 seconds, everyone within 15 blocks of you sees other players' skins and names constantly changing. 45 second purchase cooldown.
roleinfo.skill.morphling.forged_potion.e: Buy for 75 coins in the shop: right-click to choose any player (including yourself and dead players), then use it on a body to give it that player's skin. Consumed on use; a sane Coroner sees through the forgery, but the Attendant's register is fooled.
roleinfo.skill.toxicologist.antidote.eff:
Start with an Antidote on a 2-minute initial cooldown.
Against a player within 3 blocks (hold right-click, 1.5s charge):
- Poisoned: cure them (plays a sound)
- Healthy: grant an antidote shield that negates their next poisoning (silent)
Against a food platter or drink tray (instant right-click):
- Poisoned: remove the poison
- Clean: shield it, so the next poisoning attempt is negated (the poisoner's vial is still spent)
A shield lasts until it negates one poisoning; it is removed on death or at round end. It cannot stack on the same target.
Cooldown: 2 minutes after a successful use.
roleinfo.skill.toxicologist.see_poisoned:
You can identify poisoned food, drinks and beds. Poisoned players within your line of sight are visible.
Players carrying an antidote shield appear with a bright green outline in your line of sight, and shielded platters and drink trays constantly emit bright green particles.
roleinfo.skill.voodoo.bind_curse.effect: Buy a Voodoo Doll from the shop (starts at 50 coins, price rises by 50 per purchase, capped at 200); right-click the doll to open the binding menu and choose a player to bind — binding or switching targets consumes one doll. By default the curse only triggers when you die at another player's hands: the bound player instantly receives a title warning that voodoo magic will take effect in 10 seconds, then dies 10 seconds later. You can bind the Saint, but the Saint will not die from voodoo magic; if the bound player is the Assassin who assassinated you, the curse does not trigger.
roleinfo.skill.voodoo.bind_curse.name: Voodoo Bind
roleinfo.skill.serial_killer.psycho_rage: Press the ability key (3-minute initial cooldown, then 100 seconds) to instantly enter 30 seconds of Psycho Mode with NO armour: you get a bat and your identity is hidden, but you gain no shield. When the first frenzy ends, a 180-second death countdown begins. Using the skill again during the countdown means you die the moment that frenzy ends.
roleinfo.skill.serial_killer.nimble_knif: Your knife cooldown is always half the normal value.
roleinfo.skill.bandit.shop.effect: Buy killer items here. Grenades, psycho mode, poison vials and scorpions are unavailable; the revolver costs 225, plus a throwing axe (175) and axe recovery (125). Revolver kills reward 100 coins; when one axe throw (or one volley) kills several players, rewards decay: 100 for the first, 75 for the second, 50 for each further kill.
roleinfo.skill.bandit.shop.name: Bandit Shop
roleinfo.skill.bandit.throwing_axe.name: Throwing Axe
roleinfo.skill.bandit.throwing_axe.effec: Hold right-click to charge; release to throw. Longer charge = faster and farther, up to 60 m/s at full charge. A hit instantly kills and the axe keeps flying through further players. Its collision box is 1.25x larger for easier hits. When one axe kills several players, rewards decay: 100 for the first, 75 for the second, 50 for each further kill.
roleinfo.skill.bandit.volley.name: Volley Throw
roleinfo.skill.bandit.volley.effect: Throw every axe in your inventory at once: the axes line up with no gaps in front of you and fly out simultaneously at full-charge speed. 90 second initial cooldown and 90 second cooldown after each use. Requires at least one axe in your inventory; kills from one volley share the decayed reward sequence (100/75/50...).
roleinfo.skill.bandit.recover_axes.name: Recover Axe
roleinfo.skill.bandit.recover_axes.effec: Buy in the shop for 125 coins: recall one of the axes you have thrown that is still in the world (flying or stuck) back into your hotbar. No cooldown, repeatable; cannot be bought with no free hotbar slot or no axes of yours in the world.
roleinfo.win_condition.default.innocent: Eliminate all killers, or win when time runs out.
roleinfo.win_condition.criminal_reasoner: Correctly reason the killer of at least a third of the starting player count (rounded down) victims to win.
roleinfo.win_condition.gangster_star: Kill every other player to win.
roleinfo.win_condition.ferryman: Escort the souls of half the total player count to win.

announcement.goals.orthopedist: You are on the passenger side. Use Ancient Bone Setting on a player within 3 blocks to grant Bone Setting: 20 seconds of 25% reduced stamina consumption and 20 seconds of Speed I. If they gain Fracture during that time, Bone Setting is consumed to negate 1 Fracture stack. Cooldown: 1 minute. Your passive Agile Steps permanently reduces your own stamina consumption by 20%.
announcement.goals.ferryman: Escort the souls of half the lobby's corpses. After being struck, you gain a brief reaction window to negate that fatal attack. Each escorted corpse grants 1 blessing; a successful empowered reaction consumes 1 blessing to stun the attacker for 6 seconds and grant you Speed II for 6 seconds.
game.win.ferryman: May every soul stranded far from home one day return to where it belongs.

announcement.goals.commander: You are part of the killer faction. Other killers know your player name at the start and can identify you by a special color in instinct vision. You can open a menu to mark Threat Targets up to a total quota of one third of all players, rounded down, while keeping at most two active marks at once. Marking a third target removes the oldest active mark. If another killer eliminates them, every killer-faction player gains 50 coins. If every other killer dies, you immediately shoot yourself.
title.noellesroles.commander_last_bullet: My plans fail. Such is fate.

label.commander.title: Commander
screen.commander.title: Commander Menu
screen.commander.empty: There are no valid targets to mark
roleinfo.skill.commander.killer_id.effec: All other killers know your player name at round start and can identify you by a special instinct color. When you die, all killer-faction players are notified.
roleinfo.skill.commander.killer_id.name: Command Presence
roleinfo.skill.commander.threat_mark.eff: Press your ability key to open a target menu and mark one player as a Threat Target. Your total mark quota is one third of all players, rounded down, with a 30 second cooldown and at most two active Threat Targets at once; marking a third target removes the oldest one. If another killer kills them, all killer-faction players gain 50 coins.
roleinfo.skill.commander.last_bullet.eff: If all other killers die, your final words appear in the center of the screen and you shoot yourself after 5 seconds. Your personal kill reward is 75 coins, and you cannot buy lockpick, psycho mode, crowbar, or knife.
roleinfo.skill.commander.shop.effect: Revolver costs 150, blackout costs 300, grenade costs 400. You cannot buy lockpick, psycho mode, crowbar, or knife.
roleinfo.skill.commander.shop.name: Command Arsenal
roleinfo.skill.baosang.death_sense.name: Death Knell
roleinfo.skill.baosang.death_sense.effec: Whenever a player dies, their name is displayed on your screen after 10 seconds. The ability then enters a 30 second cooldown. Deaths caused by the Scavenger do not trigger this ability.
roleinfo.skill.baosang.passenger.effect: You are on the passenger side, have sanity and receive sanity tasks, and have limited sprint stamina.
roleinfo.skill.junker.loot_vision.name: Salvage Instinct
roleinfo.skill.junker.loot_vision.effect: You can always see dropped items through walls, highlighted within 8 blocks of you.
roleinfo.skill.junker.search_corpse.name: Search Body
roleinfo.skill.junker.search_corpse.effe: Aim at a body within 3 blocks, press your ability key and keep looking at it for 5 seconds to randomly obtain one item from the dead player's inventory after their death drops were resolved. The ability then goes on a 60 second cooldown. Each body can only be searched once. Searched items you are carrying (except the room key, walkie-talkie and neutral master key) block you from searching again, and your hotbar must have a free slot. Except for the room key, items obtained by searching are destroyed after use; you can also hold one in your main hand and sneak-right-click into the air to destroy it on purpose.
roleinfo.skill.economist.shop.name: Financial Shop
roleinfo.skill.economist.shop.effect: Completing tasks earns you coins. Open your shop with the inventory key; it sells the Economic Report for 50 coins.
roleinfo.skill.economist.economic_report: For 20 seconds after buying it, a line below your coin display shows, live, the coin count of the richest other player on the train. The shop is out of stock during those 20 seconds and restocks when the observation ends.
roleinfo.skill.white_knight.revolver.eff: You start with a revolver. Its cooldown follows the police standard of 10 seconds. Shooting a passenger costs sanity like any other passenger, and killing a good person brings the map's own punishment.
roleinfo.skill.white_knight.psycho_visio: You always see psycho-mode players through walls; kills you cause ignore their psycho shield.
roleinfo.skill.white_knight.bounty.name: Knight's Bounty
roleinfo.skill.white_knight.bounty.effec: When a killer kills you (including indirect ways such as poison), they only receive 50% of the standard kill reward. When a neutral kills you, every living killer receives 50 coins; if you die without a killer (or at a passenger's hand), every living killer receives 150 coins. All killer payouts and their hints are delayed until 10 seconds after your death, while every spectator and living passenger immediately hears three bell tolls — the passengers always learn of your death first.
roleinfo.skill.breacher.create_break_poi: Starts on a 60 second opening cooldown. Press the ability key once in a valid indoor 3x3 standable space to mark your position, then press it again within 60 seconds while still nearby to create a Break Point. The point lasts 120 seconds and is visible through walls. If no non-killer player maintains it by staying in its 3x3 area for 10 continuous seconds, the killer side splits 100 coins. After the point disappears, the skill enters a 180 second cooldown.
roleinfo.skill.phonism.hallucinate.name: Plant a Hallucination
roleinfo.skill.phonism.hallucinate.effec: Starts on a 45 second opening cooldown, then a 60 second cooldown after each use. Press the ability key to open the menu: pick a player, then pick a sound. The sound plays from that player's position for everyone nearby. If the chosen player is dead, no sound is played, but the skill still goes on cooldown.
announcement.goals.saint: You are on the passenger side. You have no sanity, cannot pick up guns, and are immune to voodoo magic. Press your ability key to invoke Hellfire for 15 seconds. If you are killed during that window, your killer is permanently burdened with Karma until the round ends: after every later kill or item use, they cannot kill or use items again for 5 seconds. If the killer is the Bomber, that lock lasts 20 seconds. If Hellfire expires without you being killed, it goes on a 60 second cooldown. Innocent-side attacks cannot kill you.
tip.saint.karmic_debt: You are permanently burdened with Karma until the round ends.
tip.saint.karma_triggered: Karma backlash: you cannot kill or use items for %s seconds

replay.skill.noellesroles.breacher.rewar: %s's break point at %s was not maintained; killers split %s coins
roleinfo.skill.saint.hellfire.name: Hellfire
roleinfo.skill.saint.hellfire.effect: Press your ability key to activate Hellfire for 15 seconds. If you are killed during that window, your killer is permanently burdened with Karma until the round ends. After every later successful kill or item use, they cannot kill or use items again for 5 seconds. If that killer is the Bomber, the lock lasts 20 seconds instead. If you survive the 15 seconds, Hellfire goes on a 60 second cooldown.
roleinfo.skill.saint.divine_focus.name: Divine Focus
roleinfo.skill.saint.divine_focus.effect: You have no sanity, cannot pick up guns, and are immune to voodoo magic. If an innocent-side player tries to kill you, that kill is canceled.

announcement.goals.dream_eater: Plant drowsiness in the dreams of others. Marked passengers gain a task to sleep and burn through their sanity until they rest — strike the same victim three times and their next sleep will be their last.
roleinfo.summary.dream_eater: Mark players to give them a sleep task and speed up their sanity drain; land three hits to lull them into eternal sleep. You can see players holding sleep tasks through walls.
roleinfo.skill.dream_eater.dream_mark.ef: Starts on a 45 second opening cooldown, then 30 seconds per use. Mark an aimed player within 3 blocks and line of sight: after 10 seconds they feel drowsy, receive a "You are being watched by the Dream Eater: go to sleep!" task (it does not share a slot with the vanilla sleep task, so the two can coexist), and their sanity drain is permanently raised by one level (removed once that sleep task is completed). On the third hit (including sleeping-pill food), the message becomes "you feel deeply exhausted" and their next completed sleep task kills them, ignoring shields. An eternal-sleep kill awards 100 coins, and the other killer teammates share 50 coins.
roleinfo.skill.dream_eater.sleeping_pill: Use on a food platter or drink tray (same poisoning method as the poison vial, 50 coins). Whoever eats it counts as hit by your skill; the killer side can see blue particles rising from sleeping-pill plates. Anyone who finds the pill can use it, and toxicologist plate shields do not block or get consumed by it.
Like the Bomber seeing bomb carriers, you see every player who holds a sleep task through walls.
item.noellesroles.sleeping_pill.tooltip:
Use on a food platter or drink tray to poison it
Whoever eats it counts as hit by the Dream Eater's skill and grows drowsy
item.noellesroles.scorpion_x3.tooltip:
Receive 3 scorpions immediately on purchase
Place a scorpion on a bed to poison the next player who sleeps in it
item.noellesroles.curtain.tooltip:
Instantly black out the lights for half the normal duration (15–20s)
Separate 5 minute cooldown
